header.title: Test reports
header.description: Review every terminal test Run for “{{name}}”. Each immutable Revision is shown as static HTML, Markdown is downloadable, and raw logs and Artifacts remain in the original Run.

skillScore.emptySelection: Select an AI score report from the list.
skillScore.loadError: Could not load the AI score report.

empty.title: No terminal test reports yet
empty.description: A report is generated automatically when a test Run completes, fails, is canceled, or is interrupted.
empty.filteredDescription: Clear some filters or inspect the report status from Test runs.

detail.staticNotice: The report body is script-free static HTML. JSON remains an internal fact protocol and is not offered as a user export.

GENERATION_PENDING.title: Generating the static report
GENERATION_PENDING.description: This page refreshes automatically. The original Run and completed evidence are unchanged.

GENERATION_FAILED.title: Report generation failed
GENERATION_FAILED.description: Retrying is safe and does not modify the Run or its source evidence.

UNAVAILABLE.title: The current historical facts cannot produce a report
UNAVAILABLE.description: Open the original Run to inspect any logs, Cases, and Artifacts that remain available.

AVAILABLE.title: The static document is not ready
AVAILABLE.description: The report status and Revision are inconsistent. Retry loading the report.

PARTIAL.title: The static document is not ready
PARTIAL.description: The report status and Revision are inconsistent. Retry loading the report.

analysis.title: Report Analyzer
analysis.disclaimer: The Analyzer uses the capabilities from project settings.json and reads the frozen report, selected Cases, and context files prepared in its workspace.
analysis.generatedNotice: AI analysis is a model-generated interpretation layer. It does not replace the deterministic fact report or declare a winner, release decision, or root cause.

selection.title: Select Cases to analyze
selection.description: Cases with issues are selected by default; when there are no issues, every Case is selected. Each request creates an independent Analysis Revision.
selection.unavailable: This Report Revision has no Cases available for the Analyzer.

analysis.loadErrorDescription: The fact report remains available. Retry loading the independent Analysis Revision.
analysis.emptyDescription: Select the Cases to analyze, then start an Analyzer Session with the project's shared capabilities.
analysis.runningDescription: A separate script-free static HTML document will appear when it finishes. The fact report and its Revision will not change.
analysis.failedDescription: Failure does not affect the fact report. You can create a new Analysis Revision with the same Cases.
analysis.meta: Actual model {{model}} · configured model {{configuredModel}} · Prompt {{prompt}} · {{count}} Cases
